companies.overview:
At ContactOut, we pride ourselves on being the most accurate contact data intelligence tool out there. Find emails and phone numbers for 300M professionals, including B2B data for 30M companies.

Our platform is trusted by 1.4M sales, marketing, and recruitment professionals in over 76% of Fortune 500 companies like Google, Microsoft and Netflix.

Our key features are designed with users in mind, so you can easily:
1) Find quality prospects fast all in one place with our Search Portal
2) Supercharge your LinkedIn prospecting with our Chrome Extension
3) Personalize and automate their outbound messaging with our Email Campaign

Our platform is the perfect way to take your business to the next level. With our powerful tools and accurate data, you'll be able to reach more prospects than ever before and see real results. 

Try for free today at www.contactout.com

companies.name: DN Urbland
companies.overview:
DN Urbland wants to make a difference in spatial design. The office fullfills this mission by planning and designing, creating development initiatives and actively taking part in the current large scale spatial planning discussion: quality of landscape development, quality of living in our cities, better accessibility and making our land climate-proof. We design with and for the citizens.

Integral approach
All scales are part of the design and realisation of our designs. We solve the spatial problems of our times by connecting various sectors and disciplines: complex issues require innovative solutions to create possibilities.

Interactive working method
Our plans are developed in intensive co-operation with all involved parties. The process and contents are thus tightly bound with each other and thus form an integral part of the solution. The interactivity during the planning process results in stronger and widely accepted and many times even suprising, more ambitious designs!
